topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 84 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 7 ERC20 tokens, 7 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 17 common project-authored base contract(s) (aavev3payload, baseimmutableadminupgradeabilityproxy, baseupgradeabilityproxy). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
